policy.active_listing: manual source review status pass against the approved launch-freeze source
policy.archived_listing: manual source review status review, hold, or source_unavailable
policy.publication_boundary: catalog classification is not broker or publication approval
policy.archived_surface: terminal 200, explicitly unavailable, excluded from active search
policy.unresolved_content: propose 410 when no approved equivalent exists; never publish review-only crawl text
policy.route_approval_boundary: approval-required proposals are not deployable until explicitly approved

known_gaps: makler-realty.ru registration has expired. 52 of the 165 listing 301s and 179 of the 457 decisions originate there; they cannot be served until the domain is renewed.
production/data/redirect-approval-workbook.csv is the review input workbook, not a decision artefact. The decisions here come from launch-freeze.json only.
The 38 merged .ru duplicates keep their own 301, and that 301 targets the archived duplicate rather than the surviving .com listing.
